source: PC This Little Piggy: the viewer rating's live increments in Badinfos' run (docs/PC_VS_MOBILE.md): 10, 20, 15, 7, 8, 13, 15 for the seven tricks against the mobile data's alarm 13, pig 20, slip 7, milk 20, chips 0 (the Chili's 15 is routed through DependsOn = CornChips, whose TrickScore is 0), teeth 15, bed 8 — the PC pays the milk 10 and the chips 15. PC data (level_pig/tricks.xml): babybottle_nitro 20, pigout 10, cookiebox_hot 15 — the video reading had the milk's 10 and the pig's 20 the other way round; the milk keeps the mobile 20, the pig pays 10. PC anger (game.exe, docs/PC_ROUTINES.md "The anger and the bonus"): PCAngryTime on the Rottweiler is level_pig/level.xml's angrytime=192 (1/12 s ticks: the level state ticks 12 times a second, as the HUD clock shows) — the rage current a trick without its own value is set to and the mercury's full scale; PCAngryTime on an item is its tricks.xml angrytime (Ground 252, PigMilk 240); the profile holds the current 60 ticks, counts it down one per tick and pays +3 for a trick fired while it is above zero (pcprofile.s1_rage_*).
